candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations, causing order to fail and gateway checkout to return 502; the fault originates in the payment dependency, not in order or inventory.
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-service metrics, logs, or traces were admitted, so the internal cause of the 503 (e.g. saturation, config, dependency) is unestablished.

report.explanation: Traces show inventory reservations succeeding (200) while payment authorizations return 503, propagating to order 502 and gateway checkout 502. Gateway and order metrics corroborate 502s on /v1/checkout and /v1/orders. The bounded candidate is a payment-side failure surfaced as http-500 class errors; payment telemetry is missing, so the internal cause is not established.
missing_evidence: Payment service metrics (request status, latency, dependency operations) to confirm the 503 origin and rule out order-side faults
Payment service logs/traces for the /v1/authorizations 503 to identify the internal failure mode
Order service traces (excluded) to confirm the payment call is the failing step in each request
